tool.name: CIRCexplorer
tool.description: annotate circular RNAs from fusion junction reads

param.name: fusion
param.label: TopHat-Fusion fusion junction BAM
param.help: Fusion BAM file generated by TopHat/TopHat-Fusion

param.name: ref
param.label: Gene annotation
param.help: Gene annotation file in RefSeq-like format (as produced by fetch_ref.py)

param.name: no_fix
param.label: Skip fixing of fusion junctions
param.help: This option is useful for species with poor gene annotations.

tool.help:
# CIRCexplorer
CIRCexplorer identifies junction reads from back-spliced exons and intron lariats, and is therefore able to identify and quantify circular RNAs (circRNAs and ciRNAs).
CIRCexplorer is now only a circular RNA annotating tool, which parses fusion junction information from the results of other aligner mapping strategies (TopHat/TopHat-Fusion or STAR). The annotation of circular RNAs depends on the aligner's own mapping strategy, so results may differ between aligners.
-----
## Input
- **Source of fusion junction information**: either a TopHat-Fusion fusion BAM file, or a STAR `Chimeric.out.junction` file (which is converted internally with `star_parse.py`). - **Reference genome**: genome sequence in FASTA format. - **Gene annotation**: RefSeq-like gene annotation, e.g. as generated by the `fetch_ref.py` script shipped with CIRCexplorer.
-----
## Output
A tabular file with the annotated circular RNAs.
**Note:** CIRCexplorer2 and CIRCexplorer3 provide more advanced pipelines for circular RNA analysis; this tool wraps the original CIRCexplorer release.
